title: Superpower reveal
description: A wrapper that fades its content in and lifts it a few pixels as it scrolls into view, with a step number for staggered rows. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation; without support, or with reduced motion, the content is simply there.
notes: the reveal runs over a fixed 260px of scroll after the element's top enters, plus 40px per step
name: superpower-reveal

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (div by default; li inside lists, tr in tables)

props.name: step
props.description: position in a staggered row: 0, 1, 2… each arrives a little later

props.name: rise
props.description: how far it rises, in px (22 for cards, 12 for table rows)
